svg.text: Third-Party and Vendor Risk Management | AWS Architecture
Target design, not yet deployed. Purple lines follow a vendor from intake to a scored registry entry and dashboard.
A vendor submits the intake form through API Gateway, and the intake handler records the request.
SIG questionnaires and SOC 2 reports land in a private S3 bucket encrypted with the document key.
The S3 upload event starts the Step Functions risk scoring workflow.
Textract reads text and tables; Comprehend pulls entities such as report period, exceptions, and subservice orgs.
The risk scorer assigns inherent and residual risk and a vendor tier.
The scored result is written to the DynamoDB vendor registry.
Scheduler sets a reassessment date per tier; when it is due, the trigger emails the vendor through SES.
A CloudWatch dashboard shows the tiers from the registry, and the risk owner reviews each tier.
Overdue reassessments and high risk results alert the risk owner through SNS.
CloudWatch alarms watch the workflow; KMS encrypts vendor documents and the registry.
